* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cardo (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “[Pilot] 2. While an [Episode VII] objective on table, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is •Arm Cannon (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 &gt; defense value).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Cardo]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Cardo]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Cardo”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
